Bought the camera for personal use, have used it a couple times and it is great. To be honest I think the tool could be elevated a lot with a plastic head attachment to spread and hold the head in the center of the pipe. You would need to ensure that the attachment do not come off in the pipe. But I think it could be a huge plus. Overall happy with the purchase, I am certain I will be buying more from vevor!
